scoring_justification: Cannot recompute |M|² from the submitted CSV alone (wavefunctions not present); the main claim is a relative sensitivity trend, which can be verified structurally from the output.

intensity.description: Square magnitude of Ps formation matrix element, dimensionless

outputs.description: The CSV file contains the computed |M|² for each λ⁻¹ value and variation case. The file is audited structurally: the verifier checks that all intensities are physically plausible (positive and within a generous bound) and that the data are internally consistent across the three variation cases.

output_contract.notes: The target policy is structural audit; no exact numeric tolerance is applied. The checker will verify the relative ordering of intensity changes across the three cases.

steps.description: Verify that electronic barrier variation yields larger intensity change than positronic variation, that simultaneous variation is largest, and that all intensities are positive and below a reasonable ceiling.
